question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Blunt
solution: The correct answer is **"Dull."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Blunt"** means (used about a knife, pencil, tool, etc.) without a sharp edge or point. ((चाक़ू आदि) कुंद, भोथरा) • **Example**: *That knife is **blunt**__.* • Synonym of **"blunt" **is** "dull."** • **"Dull"** means lacking sharpness or intensity. (तीक्ष्णता या तीव्रता का अभाव) __ • **Example**: *The pencil was so **dull**__ that it couldn't even make a mark on the paper.* • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "Cheerful"**, means happy and optimistic. (प्रसन्‍न, प्रमुदित; हँसमुख) • **Option 3, "Valiant"**, means brave and courageous. (साहसी और निर्भीक) • **Option 4, "Sharp"**, means having a thin edge or point. (तेज़ धार या नोंक वाला, धारदार या नोकदार; जो आसानी से किसी वस्‍तु को काट दे या उसमें छेद कर दे, पैना, तीक्ष्‍ण) 38:T9e4, The correct answer is **"Gorgeous."**
